content.title: Is Kuber Resources' (KUBR) Efficiency Push Enough to Offset Quarterly Sales Weakness?
content.summary: Kuber Resources Corporation reported earnings for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2025, showing a sharp year-over-year drop in quarterly sales to US$775,247 and net income to US$9,721. Despite quarterly weakness, the company’s year-to-date net income more than doubled to US$3.1 million, pointing toward possible gains in efficiency or reduced costs. We'll now explore how improved year-to-date profitability amid quarterly sales weakness alters Kuber Resources' investment...
